findings.summary: TATE MEDIA LIMITED (08209196): Tristan Tate webcam-window shell, 51 Julius Gardens Luton, incorporated Sep 2012, struck off May 2014 without filing accounts
findings.detail: TATE MEDIA LIMITED (Companies House 08209196) was incorporated on 11 September 2012 — the same month as the start of the UK criminal charge window for the 'controlling prostitution for gain' allegation. The company was registered at 51 Julius Gardens, Luton LU3 3SG, the confirmed address of the Tate brothers' webcam studio. Sole director and secretary: Tristan Tate. No SIC code ever filed; no accounts filed. Compulsorily struck off 13 May 2014. Only three filings: incorporation, GAZ1, GAZ2.

findings.summary: VIXELS LTD (08452936): Tristan Tate webcam studio shell, name suggests adult video content, incorporated Mar 2013 at Luton studio address, struck off Nov 2014 without accounts
findings.detail: VIXELS LTD (Companies House 08452936) was incorporated on 20 March 2013 at 51 Julius Gardens, Luton LU3 3SG. Sole director and secretary: Tristan Tate. No SIC code or accounts filed. Compulsorily struck off 4 November 2014. The name 'Vixels' is a portmanteau of 'vixen' (attractive woman) and 'pixels' (digital/online content), strongly suggesting a webcam or online adult content production entity. The company operated for approximately 20 months during the exact charge window before being dissolved for non-filing.

findings.summary: Talisman Poland Sp. z o.o. (KRS 0000937942): equal 50/50 ownership by both Tate brothers, incorporated Dec 2021 Warsaw, web portals and advertising activities
findings.detail: Talisman Poland Spółka z Ograniczoną Odpowiedzialnością (KRS 0000937942) was incorporated on 9 December 2021 in Warsaw, Poland (ul. Sielecka 39/3, 00-738 Warsaw). Directors and equal shareholders: Emory Andrew Tate and Tristan Tate (50 shares each, 5,000 PLN total capital). NIP: 5213949009. Business activities: web portals (63.12.Z), data processing (63.11.Z), public relations (70.21.Z), advertising intermediation, retail via internet. This is the Tate brothers' directly-owned Polish legal entity, mirroring Talisman Enterprises SRL (Romania) in name and activities.

findings.summary: Adultwork (UK adult webcam platform) confirmed as Tate brothers' revenue source in CCDC v TTJ judgment — operative during 2012–2015 charge window
findings.detail: CCDC v TTJ judgment (Westminster Magistrates' Court, December 2024), paragraph 15: 'Adultwork, which is an online adult services platform including web cam models' was explicitly named as a confirmed revenue source for the Tate brothers' accounts between 2014 and 2022. Adultwork is UK-based and would have been operational during the 2012–2015 charge window. The judgment finds £21 million was received across seven frozen accounts 2014–2022.

findings.summary: DEK-CO (UK) LTD (06865246) confirmed as UK Paxum payment arm in CCDC judgment; director Anton Postolnikov also co-owns Paxum Bank Dominica; both Tate brothers hold Paxum accounts
findings.detail: CCDC v TTJ judgment (Westminster Magistrates' Court, December 2024), paragraph 15(d): 'Dek-Co, is a UK payment platform which processes payments on behalf of Paxum Inc, with whom the Respondent brothers both have accounts.' DEK-CO (UK) LTD (Companies House 06865246) is incorporated 31 March 2009, Active, FCA-regulated, address Suite 4 Cranbrook House, 61 Cranbrook Road, Ilford IG1 4PG. Director Anton Postolnikov is the co-owner of Paxum Bank (Dominica). FCA imposed severe restrictions on Dek-Co in September 2023.

findings.summary: IM Following Sp. z o.o. (Poland, KRS 875430) paid $1.16M+ USD into Andrew Tate's Global Currency Exchange account in 2022 as 'influencer marketing and processing' commissions
findings.detail: CCDC v TTJ judgment, Account 6 section: Andrew Tate's Global Currency Exchange account (Account 6) received '$1,160,861 (USD) and €175,884 (EUR) from I M Spolka Z Orgraniczona with the first credit of $133,906 being received on 6/9/2022.' The judgment also states the account received approximately £1.1m in credits between August–December 2022 from the companies 'IM Following Spolka Z Ograniczona' and 'Empire Legal PLCC', referenced as 'commission, influencer marketing and processing.' IM Following Sp. z o.o. has KRS 0000875430, director Nicholas Francis Thomas (British), 80% shareholder NICUSZ LTD. The payment description aligns with War Room affiliate commission processing.

findings.summary: Tate's own YouTube statement (in CCDC judgment): confirmed 70/30 revenue split with false 50/50 representation, and using tax control as a mechanism to 'control your woman' in webcam operation
findings.detail: CCDC v TTJ judgment, exhibit SLB/02 (YouTube transcript): EAT stated 'I used to pay my girls 30 percent so for every ten thousand dollars they made I'd give them three and I'd keep seven. They thought they were on fifty percent and I said that the disparity was because of taxes.' And: 'tax is also another important element for controlling your woman, they're not going to pay anybody tax because you're getting paid in Bitcoin... tell your girl that you're paying the tax because girls are lazy and girls are stupid.' This constitutes EAT's own description of the financial control and revenue-split mechanism that directly maps to the SOA 2003 s.53 'controlling prostitution for gain' charge conduct elements.
